name: Intergalactic Conference Room
description: A vast chamber designed to accommodate beings of all shapes, sizes, and number of dimensions. The conference table is a perfect circle, square, and triangle simultaneously. Chairs adapt to any anatomy. A holographic projector displays presentations in formats your brain can't quite process. Coffee and snacks cater to every metabolism (including silicon-based). Alien delegates argue about trade agreements in seventeen languages. The whiteboard has equations that make physicists cry. Climate control accommodates temperatures from -273°C to 'surface of a star.'
